description: A dim, weathered room with a wooden table in the foreground. On the table are a stack of folded cloths with blue stripes, a dark wooden crucifix, a metal pitcher and two or three metal bowls. A barred window on the back wall shows a blurred street with figures and hanging laundry. The walls are peeling plaster with exposed brick. Painterly, oil-like style. No people in the foreground, no text, no visible frame.
